root_cause.reason: The run names the configuration update as the trigger (u4) but not the mechanism: the control-plane routing gap causing hosts to drop the private IP range. That is the trigger without the mechanism, so partial.

contributing_factors/0.reason: No run item mentions the payload passing validations or safeguards failing to block the deployment.

contributing_factors/1.reason: No run item says health-checking protocols ran on separate address spaces and so missed the dropped range.

contributing_factors/2.reason: No run item mentions non-vSAN-replicated workloads being pinned to a single zone.
